name: [1] CONFIG
info: STAGE 1 - CONFIG. The shared settings of ALL flows live in node 1.1 CONFIG, the only node to edit: root folder, credentials, sites with their asset ids and production-day start, exclusions. It stores them in global context (global.get("cfg")). It runs on deploy and when you click Apply. After a change, click Apply, then run the flow you want to test.
